Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 38, "heading": "CHAPTER 36. ENTHUSIASM", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u038-b0030", "target": "Доктор остановился, с улыбкой снова хлопнул меня по плечу и воскликнул с торжеством, на которое было приятно смотреть, словно я проник в глубочайшие тайники человеческой мудрости: — Мой дорогой юный друг, вы попали в точку. Это и есть Словарь!", "source_sha256": "732973c043eb6f6bcade68fb579b043cf71911b243effcfa57b34b4b89c63b72", "target_id": "ru-en85-u038-b0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a89f12eafce0a1a692c5f1ea21c008d3f5d4ccf7bace0568f2cf03c315926688"}, {"source_id": "en85-u038-b0031", "target": "Чем же это могло быть ещё! Его карманы были набиты им так же, как и голова. Словарь торчал из него во все стороны. Он рассказал мне, что с тех пор как оставил школьную жизнь, он удивительно продвинулся в работе, и что ничто не могло бы подойти ему лучше предложенного распорядка утренних и вечерних занятий, так как днём он обычно гуляет в своей шапке для размышлений. Бумаги его пребывали в некотором беспорядке из-за того, что мистер Джек Мэлдон недавно предложил свои услуги в качестве переписчика, а к такому занятию не привык; но мы скоро исправим всё, что не так, и пойдём как по маслу. Потом, когда мы уже всерьёз взялись за работу, я нашёл усилия мистера Джека Мэлдона куда более досадными, чем ожидал: он не ограничился многочисленными ошибками, но нарисовал на рукописи доктора столько солдат и женских головок, что я часто запутывался в лабиринтах неразберихи.", "source_sha256": "1ba1448855c7adb4e9809918a61a108ac37c20946b6710674ce7e066cb98ed22", "target_id": "ru-en85-u038-b0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "bd36ed9800a347178b2ede60d14f93a6e828cc94ff7e2ab36c455e919564dd7e"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 36, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u038-b0032", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The Doctor was quite happy in the prospect of our going to work together on that wonderful performance, and we settled to begin next morning at seven o’clock. We were to work two hours every morning, and two or three hours every night, except on Saturdays, when I was to rest. On Sundays, of course, I was to rest also, and I considered these very easy terms.", "sha256": "03389afeef833ea0dd3f938b43596521221d2064e3a03c5c697bd529add36a87", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[32]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0033", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Our plans being thus arranged to our mutual satisfaction, the Doctor took me into the house to present me to Mrs. Strong, whom we found in the Doctor’s new study, dusting his books,—a freedom which he never permitted anybody else to take with those sacred favourites.", "sha256": "114dc370130876b5da9b5991da7d8de1aa2200dc23df98a39a88ca424819a3db", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[33]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0034", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "They had postponed their breakfast on my account, and we sat down to table together. We had not been seated long, when I saw an approaching arrival in Mrs. Strong’s face, before I heard any sound of it. A gentleman on horseback came to the gate, and leading his horse into the little court, with the bridle over his arm, as if he were quite at home, tied him to a ring in the empty coach-house wall, and came into the breakfast parlour, whip in hand. It was Mr. Jack Maldon; and Mr. Jack Maldon was not at all improved by India, I thought. I was in a state of ferocious virtue, however, as to young men who were not cutting down trees in the forest of difficulty; and my impression must be received with due allowance.", "sha256": "c5cb027325c300dfbc4e2bb05f82db7002775797a7fdde72c2707bd261a1c3f7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[34]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0035", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Mr. Jack!’ said the Doctor. ‘Copperfield!’", "sha256": "9e8d1be9003a0e5cfbc17f0455fb947844e93e420d84875a2272bf06db5af6fd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[35]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0036", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mr. Jack Maldon shook hands with me; but not very warmly, I believed; and with an air of languid patronage, at which I secretly took great umbrage. But his languor altogether was quite a wonderful sight; except when he addressed himself to his cousin Annie. ‘Have you breakfasted this morning, Mr. Jack?’ said the Doctor.", "sha256": "3403addc5a9132ee5b2723b56ede844f14655f569fcb4c0844bb913dc5b32f2f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[36]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0037", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I hardly ever take breakfast, sir,’ he replied, with his head thrown back in an easy-chair. ‘I find it bores me.’", "sha256": "dc652f59ae26cfd18d3d7b59502d54bfe1932fcf5eba2f23f6edde327a288b52", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[37]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0038", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Is there any news today?’ inquired the Doctor.", "sha256": "1f95329b512aa17f029e28af81b527671ebb730813c822d1c9f55ae457cfd70a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[38]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0039", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Nothing at all, sir,’ replied Mr. Maldon. ‘There’s an account about the people being hungry and discontented down in the North, but they are always being hungry and discontented somewhere.’", "sha256": "bebf239f563cb389f1e1b534b656949eae8e8c57bebf7e80ace1debb69e19ccb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[39]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0040", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The Doctor looked grave, and said, as though he wished to change the subject, ‘Then there’s no news at all; and no news, they say, is good news.’", "sha256": "8c869b0d2af8dd8163cc6ca4d7662b3dc919f86d04c04feb1992f2d40cc3ffc8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[40]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0041", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘There’s a long statement in the papers, sir, about a murder,’ observed Mr. Maldon. ‘But somebody is always being murdered, and I didn’t read it.’", "sha256": "69a9cbd0a69075a42008da2127c05fe493fcad7f36dddff48f9b7c9b7638689b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[41]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0042", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "A display of indifference to all the actions and passions of mankind was not supposed to be such a distinguished quality at that time, I think, as I have observed it to be considered since. I have known it very fashionable indeed. I have seen it displayed with such success, that I have encountered some fine ladies and gentlemen who might as well have been born caterpillars. Perhaps it impressed me the more then, because it was new to me, but it certainly did not tend to exalt my opinion of, or to strengthen my confidence in, Mr. Jack Maldon.", "sha256": "c76a0d9688ff9607165244f0e8bdcd8b514e1355c1fcc01d98234262c43a1b8a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[42]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0043", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I came out to inquire whether Annie would like to go to the opera tonight,’ said Mr. Maldon, turning to her. ‘It’s the last good night there will be, this season; and there’s a singer there, whom she really ought to hear. She is perfectly exquisite. Besides which, she is so charmingly ugly,’ relapsing into languor.", "sha256": "0480e04996c38439f565f7737b904c474550ea399cde8e7892895f8b823c2c8c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[43]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0044", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The Doctor, ever pleased with what was likely to please his young wife, turned to her and said:", "sha256": "85ead0448a6471c860056a5f16b26245c570f9d29b3c7d1312e0510f8838a865", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[44]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0045", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You must go, Annie. You must go.’", "sha256": "77ab62281f453c130eb09886e93c2cfbf0221db1f9083da1aa1894d256941c8f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[45]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0046", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I would rather not,’ she said to the Doctor. ‘I prefer to remain at home. I would much rather remain at home.’", "sha256": "922b65bfcb8ebcfc9f0459773c23dde8015e9530590b162d3536a255e6fa950c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[46]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0047", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Without looking at her cousin, she then addressed me, and asked me about Agnes, and whether she should see her, and whether she was not likely to come that day; and was so much disturbed, that I wondered how even the Doctor, buttering his toast, could be blind to what was so obvious.", "sha256": "0055b0d32848fe60611f231f41ef13537e622315461de09b607691025f833971", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[47]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0048", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "But he saw nothing. He told her, good-naturedly, that she was young and ought to be amused and entertained, and must not allow herself to be made dull by a dull old fellow. Moreover, he said, he wanted to hear her sing all the new singer’s songs to him; and how could she do that well, unless she went? So the Doctor persisted in making the engagement for her, and Mr. Jack Maldon was to come back to dinner. This concluded, he went to his Patent place, I suppose; but at all events went away on his horse, looking very idle.", "sha256": "ce37eab352e23596e51c0df9b3b859d5f07ea9cee3d85c0b22dcd987ead25a45", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[48]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0049", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I was curious to find out next morning, whether she had been. She had not, but had sent into London to put her cousin off; and had gone out in the afternoon to see Agnes, and had prevailed upon the Doctor to go with her; and they had walked home by the fields, the Doctor told me, the evening being delightful. I wondered then, whether she would have gone if Agnes had not been in town, and whether Agnes had some good influence over her too!", "sha256": "42f9d0122b8894ea2f7f4c47e6b47318b4b32bfafa762111b523757cb16b1f02", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[49]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0050", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She did not look very happy, I thought; but it was a good face, or a very false one. I often glanced at it, for she sat in the window all the time we were at work; and made our breakfast, which we took by snatches as we were employed. When I left, at nine o’clock, she was kneeling on the ground at the Doctor’s feet, putting on his shoes and gaiters for him. There was a softened shade upon her face, thrown from some green leaves overhanging the open window of the low room; and I thought all the way to Doctors’ Commons, of the night when I had seen it looking at him as he read.", "sha256": "28c06db58b56002827a23dfcc364a80db7a8efdda8eadd47fe66cd0d3a1af3c5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[50]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0051", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I was pretty busy now; up at five in the morning, and home at nine or ten at night. But I had infinite satisfaction in being so closely engaged, and never walked slowly on any account, and felt enthusiastically that the more I tired myself, the more I was doing to deserve Dora. I had not revealed myself in my altered character to Dora yet, because she was coming to see Miss Mills in a few days, and I deferred all I had to tell her until then; merely informing her in my letters (all our communications were secretly forwarded through Miss Mills), that I had much to tell her. In the meantime, I put myself on a short allowance of bear’s grease, wholly abandoned scented soap and lavender water, and sold off three waistcoats at a prodigious sacrifice, as being too luxurious for my stern career.", "sha256": "3d9eac83295334f28b05705f8919d568b23acc603307383a97834143c32b2d56", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[51]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0052", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Not satisfied with all these proceedings, but burning with impatience to do something more, I went to see Traddles, now lodging up behind the parapet of a house in Castle Street, Holborn. Mr. Dick, who had been with me to Highgate twice already, and had resumed his companionship with the Doctor, I took with me.", "sha256": "5993b539915707ec97d506b40c90c937e3c2495c5cd94c47be27a0a6549b31fd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[52]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0053", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I took Mr. Dick with me, because, acutely sensitive to my aunt’s reverses, and sincerely believing that no galley-slave or convict worked as I did, he had begun to fret and worry himself out of spirits and appetite, as having nothing useful to do. In this condition, he felt more incapable of finishing the Memorial than ever; and the harder he worked at it, the oftener that unlucky head of King Charles the First got into it. Seriously apprehending that his malady would increase, unless we put some innocent deception upon him and caused him to believe that he was useful, or unless we could put him in the way of being really useful (which would be better), I made up my mind to try if Traddles could help us. Before we went, I wrote Traddles a full statement of all that had happened, and Traddles wrote me back a capital answer, expressive of his sympathy and friendship.", "sha256": "876597f35346b589debb300c587a2c444ea720eb0802e7309c3a2689e84dc73c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[53]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0054", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "We found him hard at work with his inkstand and papers, refreshed by the sight of the flower-pot stand and the little round table in a corner of the small apartment. He received us cordially, and made friends with Mr. Dick in a moment. Mr. Dick professed an absolute certainty of having seen him before, and we both said, ‘Very likely.’", "sha256": "4d6b6325872311839c800b80535c66a6eda7d649d80c4c044ba7f6c81cf5384b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[54]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0055", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The first subject on which I had to consult Traddles was this,—I had heard that many men distinguished in various pursuits had begun life by reporting the debates in Parliament. Traddles having mentioned newspapers to me, as one of his hopes, I had put the two things together, and told Traddles in my letter that I wished to know how I could qualify myself for this pursuit. Traddles now informed me, as the result of his inquiries, that the mere mechanical acquisition necessary, except in rare cases, for thorough excellence in it, that is to say, a perfect and entire command of the mystery of short-hand writing and reading, was about equal in difficulty to the mastery of six languages; and that it might perhaps be attained, by dint of perseverance, in the course of a few years. Traddles reasonably supposed that this would settle the business; but I, only feeling that here indeed were a few tall trees to be hewn down, immediately resolved to work my way on to Dora through this thicket, axe in hand.", "sha256": "626d774938c0278eea502ec2f07b9b41d5ee570a295fb89f2e63be056af0c787", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[55]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0056", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I am very much obliged to you, my dear Traddles!’ said I. ‘I’ll begin tomorrow.’", "sha256": "00ee19e03e51eadd7c946184a4966e7d9f7633b2ba73c7c9b42b53ca329705ee", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[56]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0057", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Traddles looked astonished, as he well might; but he had no notion as yet of my rapturous condition.", "sha256": "775187504a9c71b178bee48585051f8eef62fd6b12b6ea61f9dd984374cc132e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[57]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0058", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I’ll buy a book,’ said I, ‘with a good scheme of this art in it; I’ll work at it at the Commons, where I haven’t half enough to do; I’ll take down the speeches in our court for practice—Traddles, my dear fellow, I’ll master it!’", "sha256": "191e1de1398f6f052d9bb8628df9a5ee4d2addada55826e00b6ac725d62f1e68", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[58]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0059", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Dear me,’ said Traddles, opening his eyes, ‘I had no idea you were such a determined character, Copperfield!’", "sha256": "6c40dd237cb3023fe3059a9331f5155809eb850323b1253690436ece83a1bf39", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[59]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0060", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I don’t know how he should have had, for it was new enough to me. I passed that off, and brought Mr. Dick on the carpet.", "sha256": "3b36e7f9d847560860e94c658ffb45971af5dce32805d5319cda2de9b293b747", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[60]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0061", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You see,’ said Mr. Dick, wistfully, ‘if I could exert myself, Mr. Traddles—if I could beat a drum—or blow anything!’", "sha256": "0b2a7f684851c2ed3c5c2fbc27a5d61ec6d715c8f7ba1ee5668954ed1b6d11e8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[61]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0062", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Poor fellow! I have little doubt he would have preferred such an employment in his heart to all others. Traddles, who would not have smiled for the world, replied composedly:", "sha256": "2ec1af908776eb28cef29f84bbc74a6aeca73eac8912465704d7dbf79bcffeff", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[62]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u038-b0063", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘But you are a very good penman, sir. You told me so, Copperfield?’ ‘Excellent!’ said I. And indeed he was. He wrote with extraordinary neatness.", "sha256": "838483ca7923516e8cad7c45342bb82e32efce762eb9f6baf5ccc800d9f43e27", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[43]/p[63]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
